questions.question: Which type of the power transmission is more efficient for long-distance transmission?
questions.explanation: Three-phase power is used for generation, transmission and distribution. It is used by grids to transfer power and supply heavy loads.
explanationLines: Three-phase power is used for generation, transmission and distribution.
It is used by grids to transfer power and supply heavy loads.

questions.question: The full form of VCB is.............

explanationLines: VCB uses vacuum to extinguish the arc.

questions.question: Isolator operates on ……… conditions.
options: Sometimes ON load and sometimes NO load

explanationLines: An isolator is also called a no-load breaking switch.
It is used to disconnect equipment for maintenance.

questions.question: The primary purpose of a pole-mounted substation is.............
options: To transmit electricity over long distance
To distribute and control electrical power in local area
questions.correctOption: To distribute and control electrical power in local area
questions.explanation: A pole-mounted substation transforms and distributes power. It supplies a lower voltage suitable for local use.
explanationLines: A pole-mounted substation transforms and distributes power.
It supplies a lower voltage suitable for local use.

questions.question: Which type of load is most suitable for a three-phase distribution system?

Industrial motors match that use in the unit.

questions.question: In a three-phase distribution system, the standard voltage in Nepal is...........

It also gives 230 V between phase and neutral.
